newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Prime unit water billing suspended.
newsitem.headline: Prime unit water billing suspended.

text.p: The Malaysian government has directed sewerage concession holder Indah Water Konsortium (IWK) to temporarily suspend its billing and collection activities in Kuala Lumpur and five other states effective November 1, the national Bernama news agency reported on Wednesday.

Housing and Local Government Minister Ting Chew Peh was quoted by Bernama as saying the move would enable IWK, a subsidiary of Prime Utilities Bhd, to streamline its billing system and customer accounts, pending the outcome of a government review of sewerage services.
He said the review would not interrupt IWK's sewerage services and it would continue to operate and maintain public sewerage systems and provide scheduled desludging services.
IWK was awarded the 28-year national sewerage concession in 1993, but has been dogged by negative local press reports of consumer complaints over its charges and desludging methods.
